description: Information sur les transports en commun is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. GTFS file. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. The portal shows the English title as "Information on public transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. Its keywords include capa-ajaccio, gtfs, transport-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2026-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
